_owner: Dee. The darkroom maze east of the toilets, entered through the door cell [16, 6] in level1.json. Each character is a 3 m tile: half a 6 m CELL, so 2 x 2 tiles make one cell. Tile [col, row] covers x = originX + col*3 .. +3, z = originZ + row*3 .. +3. Shifter walls 'a' stand up in phase A, 'b' in phase B; the phase flips every 4 beats.
_exitTo: Where the staff door lets you out, in metres: the back exit, cell [12, 10] in level1.json, clear of the hoof bag on the back_exit spawn.
